market.summary: Wall Street had a heavy AI sell-off on Friday night (Nasdaq -5.3%, S&P 500 in a correction), yet GIFT Nifty points to a firmer open for India because foreign money keeps rotating out of global chip stocks and into Indian large caps and banks. Fear is rising, though: India VIX jumped 7.5%. Tomorrow (Tue 24 Nov) is an exchange holiday, so today's close is the one your exit rules use for two days.

points.text: Fri 20 Nov US close: S&P 500 6,910.39 (-3.7%, now more than 10% below its 6 Oct high), Nasdaq 22,617.73 (-5.3%, negative for the year), Dow 48,147.33 (-1.9%); Nvidia, Micron and AMD each fell about 13-14%.
GIFT Nifty at 8:10 IST: 25,929 (+0.71%, about +129 points vs Friday's Nifty close of 25,800.60). Friday in Asia: Nikkei -5.1%, Kospi -4.9%, Hang Seng -1.6%; Japan is shut today.
Provisional cash flows on 20 Nov: foreign investors bought a net ₹10,308 Cr, domestic institutions sold a net ₹4,860 Cr.
Rupee about 92.66 per dollar (firm); India VIX 17.32, +7.5%. Brent settled near $92.6 on Friday (AP); the pre-market report quotes a lower figure this morning, so the oil number is not settled.
Bank Nifty closed at a record 64,635.20 on Friday; markets expect an RBI rate hike to 5.75% on 4 Dec with CPI at 6.09%.

market.watch: Whether India holds a green open against the US rout; a fade below Friday's lows with VIX rising would hit the trailing stops first. No trading tomorrow (holiday).

Friday's points still hold; the stock closed ₹224.57 above its 10 EMA (₹220.85) after the Ribbit block was absorbed at ₹219. FII buying of financials is the supportive backdrop today, but a broker is also sensitive to a risk-off turn. Tomorrow is a market holiday, so today's close decides the next two days.

points.text: 17 Nov: Ribbit Capital's two entities sold about 8.7 crore shares (1.38% of the company) at ₹219, about ₹1,905 Cr; buyers included Kotak MF, BlackRock, Societe Generale, Fidelity, BNP Paribas, Morgan Stanley, HDFC Life and Norges Bank.
NSE's block-deal report shows BlackRock funds buying at least 65.5 lakh shares at ₹219 on 17 Nov.
Ribbit still held roughly 6.9% after this sale (8.29% in Sept less 1.38%), so more supply from it is possible later.

GROWW.watch: Trade is about +2R with the stop at cost: half goes on a close below ₹220.85 (10 EMA), the rest below ₹214.14 (20 EMA).

points.text: Business transfer agreement signed 14 Nov: Sejal buys Magnumtuff India's architectural and automotive glass business (plant in Belgaum district, Karnataka, with brand, IP and staff) as a going concern for ₹40.80 Cr including land and building, closing on or before 30 Nov 2026.
The acquired unit had FY26 operating revenue of ₹36.20 Cr; the deal makes Sejal a four-plant manufacturer.
Closes since entry (exchange files): 870.35 on 16 Oct, 951.95 on 11 Nov (+1R), 877.95 on 19 Nov (below cost), 922.95 on 20 Nov.

SEJALLTD.watch: Your rule now: half below the 10 EMA (₹893.86), the rest on a close below cost ₹884.13. The deal's closing filing (by 30 Nov) is the next news.
